dataItem-lvmc5a281.text:
Nanyukie Lodge
Lemala Authentic Camps

dataItem-lvmc5a2c.text: Lemala Nanyukie is located a 60-minute drive east of the Seronera Airstrip in the park’s central region, and is superbly located with outstanding views across these fascinating ‘endless plains’. The lodge itself sits on a grassy savanna dotted with rocky kopjes and shaded by ancient giant acacia trees.

dataItem-lvmc5a2d1.text: Eastern Serengeti Tanzania

dataItem-lvmcey3l.alt: Ngorongoro Lodge Meliá Collection, a double room with floor to ceiling window view looking over the Ngorongoro crater
dataItem-lvmcey3l.name: ngorongoro-lodge-member.jpg

dataItem-lvmcey3n.text: Ngorongoro Lodge Meliá Collection

dataItem-lvmcey3q.text: The Ngorongoro Conservation Area is home to an ecosystem that is unlike any other in Tanzania. Designed with the utmost respect for the environment, this lodge allows you to sleep accompanied by the sounds of nature, wake up admiring the Ngorongoro Crater, and enjoy a truly extraordinary safari experience.

dataItem-lvmcey3s.text: Ngorongoro Conservation Area

dataItem-lvmcf3kr.alt: Escarpment Luxury Lodge Manyara, a double room with  balcony looking out over Lake Manyara
dataItem-lvmcf3kr.name: king-size-bed-with-views.jpg

dataItem-lvmcf3ks.text: Escarpment Luxury Lodge Manyara

dataItem-lvmcf3kt3.text: Perched high on the rim of the Great Rift Valley Escarpment Luxury Lodge is a serene haven overlooking the wonderful Lake Manyara below. It is only 25 km from the iconic Ngorongoro Crater National Park and a 90-minute drive to Tarangire National Park

dataItem-lvmcf3ku4.text: Lake Manyara

dataItem-lvmczuwq.text: Gran Meliá Arusha

dataItem-lvmczuws2.text: Experience the essence of Arusha with Gran Meliá. An oasis within Arusha set out on 18 acres of beautiful landscaped coffee and tea plantations. Pure tranquility with spectacular views of Mount Meru. Gran Melia Arusha offers a unique experience combining the most exciting once-in-a-lifetime safari destination with state-of-the-art conference facilities.

dataItem-lvmczuwt5.text: Arusha Mount Meru View

dataItem-lvmczuwz4.text:
Kubu Kubu
Tented Lodge

dataItem-lvmczux05.text: Kubu Kubu Tented Lodge. The Lodge camp is located in Central Serengeti on the slopes of a hill with fantastic views and it is the ideal starting point to visit the great plains at any time of the year. The camp consists of 25 luxury tents with en-suite bathroom. Each tent is a built on a wooden platform. The main house caters with a terrace, restaurant, lounge and swimming pool.

dataItem-lvmczux72.name: Screenshot 2024-04-30 at 13.48.48.png

dataItem-lvmczux9.text: Ngorongoro Serena Safari Lodge

dataItem-lvmczux96.text: Nestled high above the plains into the Crater’s jagged rim, cloaked in river stone and indigenous vines, Ngorongoro Serena Safari Lodge is barely visible to the naked eye. Framed by arched stone passages and timbered decks, its torch-lit walls are adorned with stylized cave paintings. At the stone heart of the lodge burns a glowing fire, which is kept constantly alight. Rooms are looped around the Crater rim. Each has its own rock-enclosed balcony, and all enjoy completely uninterrupted views of the volcanic amphitheatre far below

dataItem-lvmczuxb1.text: Ngorongoro Crater Rim

dataItem-lvqgnepp.name: IMG_5994.JPG

dataItem-lvqgnepr.text: Anantya Serengeti

dataItem-lvqgnepv.text: Explore the luxurious Anantya Serengeti, a newly built camp nestled in the iconic Serengeti landscape. This upscale destination offers a serene garden, a welcoming bar, and an outdoor fireplace, all under full-day security.  Additional amenities include sightseeing tours, a picnic area, and exclusive sundowner spots. Located 35 km from Seronera with airport shuttle service available, Anantya Serengeti offers an unparalleled safari experience

dataItem-lvqgnepy1.alt: Farm of Dreams Lodge Karatu , Tanzania Pool area of this beautiful hotel with double and family lodges
dataItem-lvqgnepy1.name: Farm-of-Dream-Lodge4-1030x687.jpg

dataItem-lvqgnepz2.text: Farm of Dreams Lodge

dataItem-lvqgneq1.text: Farm of Dream Lodge is home to eight villages with 48 Double Rooms and Superior Rooms built in one of the best spots in the heart of this infamous town of Karatu. The lodge is surrounded by Nature’s bounty; the beautiful flower-lined paths offer an experience with nature, birds singing from Jacaranda trees and flowers that grow to startling sizes and beauty

dataItem-lvqgneq2.text: Karatu (Close to Ngorongoro)

dataItem-lvqgneq9.alt: Nyota Luxury Camps, double room surrounded by Seronera Serengeti
dataItem-lvqgneq9.name: Nyota-Room-view.jpg

dataItem-lvqgneqa.text: Nyota Luxury Camps

dataItem-lvqgneqb.text: The Serengeti fits well into most people’s dream of an African safari, with its abundant wildlife, vast golden plains, iconic acacia trees and kopjes. Nyota Luxury Tented Camp is nestled in the heart of the Serengeti and we are blessed to have the Orangi river meandering along our camp’s borders.  Nyota (rhyme it with water) means ‘stars’ in Swahili.

dataItem-lvqgneqc.text: Seronera Serengeti

dataItem-lvqhlohn.text: Welcome to your gateway to an unforgettable safari adventure in Tanzania. Our carefully curated accommodation page features an extensive selection of over 60 lodges, camps, and hotels, ranging from cozy budget options to opulent luxury retreats located across the stunning landscapes of Tanzania. Each property has been meticulously inspected by our sales team through an annual independent hotel check, ensuring that we consistently offer the highest quality accommodations paired with exceptional service. Whether you're seeking a tranquil escape in the bush or a lavish suite with panoramic views, you'll find the perfect base for your explorations right here. Browse through our list below and click on the links to discover more about each accommodation and what they have to offer for your perfect safari experience. Please note that this is just a small section of what is on offer. Our sales team will work with you to find the best accommodation for you; this list is just a small sample of some of our top picks.
